entry.title: SunCube at the SCEV 2026 Final Pitch

link.title: SunCube at the SCEV 2026 Final Pitch

entry.content:
On 27 October 2026, our team presented SunCube at the Singapore Climate & Energy Ventures (SCEV) 2026 Final Pitch, held during SWITCH (Singapore Week of Innovation and Technology) at Marina Bay Sands. SunCube is an early-stage, NUS-originated crop-first agrivoltaic design system, and it was selected for the SCEV 2026 programme run by NTU, NUS and A*STAR.

Left: the SunCube team at the SCEV 2026 Final Pitch, SWITCH 2026, Marina Bay Sands. Right: presenting SunCube's products. Photos: SunCube team.

I worked on SunCube as part of the SCEV team, with Morgan Jones and Zhenye Fu, over the eight-week programme, with guidance from our mentor Xuan Rong Tan.

entry.title: DeepSpeed’s 2026 season, from the sidelines
entry.content:
This year I joined NTU DeepSpeed as a student mentor for the organization side; i.e., planning, logistics, and keeping everything running at the school. All the engineering work is done by the students themselves. One of the best aspects of my first PhD year so far has been to see them working up close.

The NTU DeepSpeed team with both cars at the 29th RoboRacer Competition, IFAC 2026, Busan. Photo: NTU DeepSpeed.

They ran their 2026 season in three races:

ICRA 2026 (Vienna)

  • They were 12th overall in the physical race, and had qualified sixth of seventy-eight teams in sim-racing.

IFAC 2026 (Busan)

  • They placed fifteenth of fifty-five international teams, and made it into the head-to-head finals.

The IROS 2026 Sim-Racing League

  • They took second place in this event, qualifying in first position, losing to the leader by 0.44 seconds with no crashes.
